name: QA read-only Zvid acceptance and concurrent jobs audit

parameters.content:
### Read-only quota rejection audit

This native Zvid Get Many fixture lists100 recent jobs with the existing account credential. It does not create, mutate, cancel, rerender or delete jobs, change plan counters, or spend render credits.

Run manually and inspect the sanitized output. It checks timestamp coverage around rejected execution794 and identifies any travel-itinerary-video job created in that interval, plus nonterminal account jobs. A missing timestamp or incomplete coverage fails the audit. This is a private QA fixture, not a publishable template.
